notes.title: MP Cost Update
notes.notes:
This update features reduced MP Costs and minor changes including adjusted game balancing, typo fixes, map fixes, and additional experience point chests to further reduce the need for 'grinding.' The only leveling that you may need to still do is to learn skills.

Related to this, Empire 2 is well underway and will feature much smoother and better balanced gameplay, and will even have a separate 'Easy Mode' for those who don't want ANY random battles (or at least very few).

Empire 2 will be set thirty years following the events of the first and while original characters will be featured, you won't need to have played the first game to enjoy the second. The story and characters will be more developed and I'm really excited to be turning Empire into a series!

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Releasing the week one update to the game, fixing minor issues that have been discovered.

- Fixed bug that froze game after a Chapter 4 boss fight.
- Removed the leftover sprites from a scene at the Falm Mountains.
- Octis' 'Dash' skill works correctly now
- Added a Quit Game option in the main menu
- Fixed an area you could walk through in Kal Castle
- Fixed an area you could walk through at Fort Victory
- Minor text fixes

Note: This is my first update to Steam, and I'm still nervous something will go horribly wrong. But nothing has so far! It's been a great release and I want to thank everyone who's downloaded the game, posted comments and bug reports, and shown their support. This means a lot to me!
